blocks.text: Past Simple (oddiy o'tgan zamon) shakllari qizil kitobda o'tilgan: was / were (→ qizil kitob, 10-dars), worked / went (→ qizil kitob, 11-dars), didn't / Did ...? (→ qizil kitob, 12-dars). Bu darsda asosiy savol — **qachon** Past Simple kerak va o'zbekchadagi qaysi shakllarga mos keladi. Qoida bitta: harakat **o'tmishda boshlanib, o'tmishda tugagan** va gapirayotgan payt bilan bog'lanmagan. Kecha, o'tgan yili, 2015-yilda — bu vaqtlar yopilgan, ular endi davom etmaydi.

Past Simple ko'pincha tugagan vaqtni ko'rsatadigan so'zlar bilan keladi: **yesterday**, **last week / month / year**, **two days ago**, **in 2019**, **on Monday**, **when I was a child**, **the other day** (kuni kecha). Vaqt aytilmasa ham, u kontekstdan aniq bo'lishi mumkin: hikoyada, tugagan voqea haqida yoki tarixiy faktda (Navoi **wrote** «Khamsa»). **When ...?** savoli doim Past Simple bilan keladi, chunki u aniq o'tgan vaqtni so'raydi.

items.text: Madina **moved** to London two years ago.
items.translation: Madina ikki yil oldin Londonga **ko'chib ketdi**.

items.text: We **didn't see** Tom at the conference last week.

blocks.text: Hikoya qilganda har bir Past Simple fe'l — keyingi qadam: avval biri, keyin ikkinchisi. **first**, **then**, **after that**, **as soon as**, **finally** so'zlari tartibni aniqlashtiradi. O'zbekchada bunday zanjir ko'pincha «**-ib**» bilan ulanadi: Uyga **kelib**, dush **qabul qildim** — I **came** home and **had** a shower. Inglizchada esa har bir fe'l alohida o'tgan zamonda turadi.

items.text: I **came** home, **had** a quick shower and **fell** asleep on the sofa.
items.translation: Uyga **kelib**, tezgina **dush qabul qildim** va divanda **uxlab qoldim**.

items.text: The waiter **brought** the bill, and Aziz **paid** for everyone.
items.translation: Ofitsiant hisobni **olib keldi**, Aziz esa hamma uchun **to'ladi**.

blocks.text: did — o'tgan zamon faqat bir joyda

Inkor va so'roqda o'tgan zamonni **did** «olib yuradi», asosiy fe'l esa lug'atdagi shaklda qoladi: I **didn't go** («didn't went» ✗), **Did** you **see**? («Did you saw» ✗). **be** bilan did ishlatilmaydi: **Were** you tired? («Did you be» ✗). Ega o'zi so'roq so'zi bo'lsa ham did kerak emas: **Who called** you? **What happened**? (→ 49-dars). Noto'g'ri fe'llarni guruhlab yodlash oson:

rows: oxiri bir xil eshitiladi, imlosi farq qiladi

blocks.text: Past Simple faqat bir martalik voqea uchun emas. O'tmishda **takrorlangan** harakat va **tugagan** holat ham Past Simple: When I was a student, I **worked** in a café. Davomiylik aytilsa ham (for six years), agar holat endi tugagan bo'lsa — Past Simple: We **lived** in Bukhara for ten years (endi u yerda yashamaymiz). Holat hali davom etsa — Present Perfect: We**'ve lived** here for ten years (→ 11-dars). O'tmishdagi odat uchun **used to** ham bor (→ 18-dars).

items.text: As a student, Sarah **worked** in a bookshop on Saturdays.
items.translation: Talabalik paytida Sara shanba kunlari kitob do'konida **ishlardi**.

items.text: We **lived** in Bukhara for ten years, and then we moved to Tashkent.
items.translation: O'n yil Buxoroda **yashadik**, keyin Toshkentga ko'chdik.

items: «**-di**» (bordim, ko'rdi) — eng ko'p Past Simple: Kecha kinoga **bordim** → I **went** to the cinema yesterday. Lekin natija hozir muhim bo'lsa, «-di» Present Perfect ham bo'lishi mumkin (→ 7-dars).
«**-gan**» (tug'ilganman, o'qiganman) — tarixiy fakt va hayotiy voqealar: Farg'onada **tug'ilganman** → I **was born** in Fergana; Navoiy «Xamsa»ni **yozgan** → Navoi **wrote** «Khamsa».
«**-ardi / -ar edi**» (borardik, ishlardi) — o'tmishdagi odat: Bolaligimda ko'p **o'qirdim** → I **read** a lot when I was a child (yoki I used to read).
«**edi**» (charchagan edik, yo'q edi) — o'tmishdagi holat: Mashinamiz **yo'q edi** → We **didn't have** a car.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I didn't went.» → I **didn't go**.; «Did you saw it?» → **Did** you **see** it?; «I was go to school.» → I **went** to school. (was + fe'l ✗); «Yesterday I have seen him.» → Yesterday I **saw** him. (aniq o'tgan vaqt bilan Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi, → 14-dars); «When have you arrived?» → When **did** you **arrive**?; «He was died in 1990.» → He **died** in 1990.; «I born in 2001.» → I **was born** in 2001.

O'zingizdan so'rang: «**Qachon?**» degan savolga javob bormi va o'sha vaqt **tugaganmi**? Kecha, o'tgan oy, bolaligimda, 2019-yilda — ha bo'lsa, Past Simple. Vaqt hali davom etsa (bugun, shu hafta) yoki gap hozirgi natija haqida bo'lsa — Present Perfect (→ 7–8-darslar).

Past Continuous (I was doing) → 6-dars; Present Perfect bilan farqi → 13–14-darslar; Past Perfect (o'tmishdan ham oldingi voqea) → 15-dars; used to → 18-dars; noto'g'ri fe'llarning to'liq ro'yxati → 146-dars (ilova) va qizil kitob, 117–118-darslar.

rows: Aziz **started** his new job three weeks ago.
We **lived** in Bukhara for ten years.
I **was born** in Fergana. **Were** you tired?

examples.title: Finished time: yesterday, last year, ago
examples.description: Aniq, tugagan o'tgan vaqt — yesterday, last ..., ... ago, in 2021, the other day. Tarixiy faktlar ham Past Simple da.

sentences.text: Aziz **started** his new job at the bank three weeks ago.
sentences.translation: Aziz bankdagi yangi ishini uch hafta oldin **boshladi**.

sentences.text: Last summer we **rented** a small house by Lake Charvak for ten days.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda Chorvoq ko'li bo'yida o'n kunga kichik uy **ijaraga oldik**.

sentences.text: The government **announced** the new tax rules on Monday.
sentences.translation: Hukumat yangi soliq qoidalarini dushanba kuni **e'lon qildi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **graduated** from the University of Westminster in Tashkent in 2021.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza 2021-yilda Toshkentdagi Vestminster universitetini **tamomladi**.

sentences.text: Yesterday evening we **missed** the last bus, so we **took** a taxi home.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun oxirgi avtobusga **ulgurmadik**, shuning uchun uyga taksida **qaytdik**.

sentences.text: Shakespeare **wrote** most of his plays between 1590 and 1613.
sentences.translation: Shekspir pyesalarining ko'pini 1590–1613-yillar orasida **yozgan**.

sentences.text: The other day I **met** an old classmate at the airport in Istanbul.
sentences.translation: Kuni kecha Istanbul aeroportida eski sinfdoshimni **uchratib qoldim**.

sentences.text: Emma **sold** her car last month because she **moved** closer to work.
sentences.translation: Emma ishxonasiga yaqinroq joyga **ko'chgani** uchun o'tgan oy mashinasini **sotdi**.

sentences.text: When **did** the first iPhone **come out**? — In 2007, I think.
sentences.translation: Birinchi iPhone qachon **chiqqan**? — 2007-yilda, shekilli.

sentences.text: My grandparents **got married** in 1975 and **spent** their honeymoon in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bobom bilan buvim 1975-yilda **turmush qurishgan** va asal oyini Buxoroda **o'tkazishgan**.

examples.title: A sequence of events: what happened next
examples.description: Ketma-ket voqealar: har bir Past Simple fe'l — hikoyaning keyingi qadami. first, then, after that, as soon as, finally.

sentences.text: James **woke up** late, **jumped** out of bed and **ran** to the station.
sentences.translation: Jeyms kech **uyg'ondi**, to'shakdan **sakrab turdi** va vokzalga **yugurdi**.

sentences.text: First we **visited** the Registan, then we **had** lunch in a teahouse nearby.
sentences.translation: Avval Registonni **ziyorat qildik**, keyin yaqindagi choyxonada **tushlik qildik**.

sentences.text: The thief **broke** the window, **took** the laptop and **disappeared** in seconds.
sentences.translation: O'g'ri derazani **sindirdi**, noutbukni **oldi** va bir necha soniyada **g'oyib bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Madina **opened** the letter, **read** it twice and **burst** into tears.
sentences.translation: Madina xatni **ochdi**, uni ikki marta **o'qib chiqdi** va **yig'lab yubordi**.

sentences.text: After the meeting, Tom **called** the client and **explained** the delay.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishdan keyin Tom mijozga **qo'ng'iroq qildi** va kechikish sababini **tushuntirdi**.

sentences.text: As soon as the plane **landed**, everybody **switched on** their phones.
sentences.translation: Samolyot **qo'nishi** bilan hamma telefonini **yoqdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **paid** the bill, **left** a tip and **went** out into the snow.
sentences.translation: Jasur hisobni **to'ladi**, choychaqa **qoldirdi** va qorli ko'chaga **chiqib ketdi**.

sentences.text: We **got** to the hotel at midnight, so we **went** straight to bed.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonaga yarim tunda **yetib keldik**, shuning uchun to'g'ri **uxlashga yotdik**.

sentences.text: The firefighters **arrived** quickly and **put out** the fire before it **spread**.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar tezda **yetib kelishdi** va olov **tarqalmasdan** oldin uni **o'chirishdi**.

sentences.text: Finally, Kate **found** her keys, **locked** the door and **drove** off to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat Keyt kalitlarini **topdi**, eshikni **qulfladi** va Oksfordga qarab **jo'nab ketdi**.

examples.title: Irregular verbs in the news
examples.description: Yangiliklar va voqealarda eng ko'p uchraydigan noto'g'ri fe'llar: won, lost, rose, fell, built, blew, gave, found, chose.

sentences.text: Uzbekistan **won** three gold medals in boxing at the last Olympics.
sentences.translation: So'nggi Olimpiadada O'zbekiston boksda uchta oltin medalni **qo'lga kiritdi**.

sentences.text: Oil prices **fell** sharply after yesterday's announcement.
sentences.translation: Kechagi e'londan keyin neft narxlari keskin **tushib ketdi**.

sentences.text: The company **built** a new factory near Navoi and **hired** five hundred workers.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya Navoiy yaqinida yangi zavod **qurdi** va besh yuz ishchini **ishga oldi**.

sentences.text: A strong wind **blew** down several trees in the park last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha tunda kuchli shamol parkdagi bir nechta daraxtni **qulatdi**.

sentences.text: Thousands of fans **came** to the stadium, although the tickets **cost** a fortune.
sentences.translation: Chiptalar juda qimmat **turgan bo'lsa-da**, minglab muxlislar stadionga **kelishdi**.

sentences.text: Our team **lost** the final, but the coach **said** he was proud of the players.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz finalda **yutqazdi**, lekin murabbiy o'yinchilari bilan faxrlanishini **aytdi**.

sentences.text: The minister **gave** a short speech and then **left** without answering questions.
sentences.translation: Vazir qisqa nutq **so'zladi**, keyin savollarga javob bermay **chiqib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Unemployment **rose** slightly in the spring, but it **fell** again in summer.
sentences.translation: Ishsizlik bahorda biroz **oshdi**, lekin yozda yana **kamaydi**.

sentences.text: Scientists in Oxford **found** a new way to recycle plastic bottles.
sentences.translation: Oksforddagi olimlar plastik butilkalarni qayta ishlashning yangi usulini **topishdi**.

sentences.text: In the end, voters **chose** a young mayor, which **surprised** many experts.
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat saylovchilar yosh merni **tanlashdi**, bu ko'plab ekspertlarni **hayratga soldi**.

examples.title: Negatives: **didn't** + base form
examples.description: Inkorda o'tgan zamon faqat didn't da: didn't go, didn't buy («didn't went» emas). be bilan — wasn't / weren't.

sentences.text: **I didn't sleep** well last night because the neighbours **had** a party.
sentences.translation: Kecha yaxshi **uxlamadim**, chunki qo'shnilar **bazm qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **didn't go** to the lecture — he **stayed** at home with a fever.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ma'ruzaga **bormadi** — isitmasi chiqib, uyda **qoldi**.

sentences.text: We **didn't buy** the flat in the end, because the bank **refused** the loan.
sentences.translation: Oxir-oqibat kvartirani **sotib olmadik**, chunki bank kredit berishni **rad etdi**.

sentences.text: The match **wasn't** very exciting, and nobody **scored** a goal.
sentences.translation: O'yin unchalik qiziqarli **bo'lmadi**, hech kim gol **urmadi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **didn't know** anyone at the conference, so she **felt** a bit lonely.
sentences.translation: Sara konferensiyada hech kimni **tanimasdi**, shuning uchun o'zini biroz yolg'iz **his qildi**.

sentences.text: My phone **didn't ring** — maybe you **called** the wrong number?
sentences.translation: Telefonim **jiringlamadi** — balki noto'g'ri raqamga **qo'ng'iroq qilgandirsiz**?

sentences.text: The shops **weren't** open on the holiday, so we **cooked** at home.
sentences.translation: Bayramda do'konlar **ochiq emasdi**, shuning uchun uyda ovqat **pishirdik**.

sentences.text: Oliver **didn't tell** his boss about the mistake, which **made** things much worse.
sentences.translation: Oliver xato haqida boshlig'iga **aytmadi**, bu esa vaziyatni yanada **yomonlashtirdi**.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the medicine **didn't help**, so the doctor **changed** it.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, dori **yordam bermadi**, shuning uchun shifokor uni **almashtirdi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **didn't pass** her driving test the first time, but she **passed** easily the second time.
sentences.translation: Nilufar haydovchilik imtihonidan birinchi marta **o'ta olmadi**, lekin ikkinchi safar osongina **o'tdi**.

examples.title: Questions: **Did** you ...? When **did** ...?
examples.description: So'roqda Did + ega + fe'lning asosiy shakli; so'roq so'z bilan: When / Where / Why did ...? Ega so'ralsa did kerak emas: Who told you? What happened?

sentences.text: **Did** you **watch** the match last night? — Yes, what a game!
sentences.translation: Kecha o'yinni **ko'rdingmi**? — Ha, qanday o'yin bo'ldi!

sentences.text: Where **did** you **buy** that jacket? It really suits you.
sentences.translation: O'sha kurtkani qayerdan **olding**? Senga juda yarashibdi.

sentences.text: Why **did** Kate **leave** the party so early? Was she ill?
sentences.translation: Keyt nega ziyofatdan bunchalik erta **ketdi**? Kasalmidi?

sentences.text: How **did** you **find out** about the job? — A friend **sent** me the link.
sentences.translation: Bu ish haqida qanday **bilib qolding**? — Bir do'stim havolani **yubordi**.

sentences.text: **Did** the price **include** breakfast, or **did** you **pay** extra for it?
sentences.translation: Narxga nonushta **kirganmidi** yoki uning uchun qo'shimcha **to'ladingizmi**?

sentences.text: Who **told** you about the new café near the university?
sentences.translation: Universitet yaqinidagi yangi kafe haqida sizga kim **aytdi**?

sentences.text: What **happened** to your car? — Someone **hit** it in the car park.
sentences.translation: Mashinangizga nima **bo'ldi**? — Avtoturargohda kimdir **urib ketibdi**.

sentences.text: How long **did** it **take** you to drive from Tashkent to Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Samarqandgacha mashinada qancha vaqtda **yetib bordingiz**?

sentences.text: When **did** you last **see** a doctor? — About two years ago, I think.
sentences.translation: Oxirgi marta shifokorga qachon **ko'ringansiz**? — Taxminan ikki yil oldin, shekilli.

sentences.text: What **did** the manager **say** when you **asked** for a pay rise?
sentences.translation: Maoshni oshirishni **so'raganingizda** menejer nima **dedi**?

examples.title: **was** / **were**: feelings, places and birthdays
examples.description: be ning o'tgan zamoni: was / were — holat, his-tuyg'u, joy; was born — tug'ilgan. Inkor wasn't / weren't, so'roq Was ...? / Were ...?

sentences.text: **I was** born in Fergana, but I **grew up** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Farg'onada **tug'ilganman**, lekin Toshkentda **o'sganman**.

sentences.text: Where **were** you at ten o'clock? I **called** you three times.
sentences.translation: Soat o'nda qayerda **eding**? Senga uch marta **qo'ng'iroq qildim**.

sentences.text: The flight **was** cheap, but the seats **were** incredibly uncomfortable.
sentences.translation: Reys arzon **edi**, lekin o'rindiqlar juda noqulay **edi**.

sentences.text: **Were** your parents happy when you **told** them about the wedding?
sentences.translation: To'y haqida **aytganingizda** ota-onangiz xursand **bo'lishdimi**?

sentences.text: It **wasn't** easy to find a flat in London, and the rent **was** shocking.
sentences.translation: Londonda kvartira topish oson **bo'lmadi**, ijara narxi esa dahshatli **edi**.

sentences.text: We **were** really tired after the hike, so we **didn't cook** dinner.
sentences.translation: Sayrdan keyin juda **charchagan edik**, shuning uchun kechki ovqat **pishirmadik**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **was** a teacher for forty years and **never missed** a day.
sentences.translation: Buvim qirq yil o'qituvchi **bo'lgan** va bir kun ham dars **qoldirmagan**.

sentences.text: How **was** your trip to Edinburgh? — Wonderful, but the weather **was** awful.
sentences.translation: Edinburgga safaringiz qanday **o'tdi**? — Ajoyib, lekin ob-havo dahshatli **edi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **wasn't** at the meeting because his train **was** late.
sentences.translation: Jasur yig'ilishda **yo'q edi**, chunki poyezdi **kechikdi**.

sentences.text: There **were** so many people at the bazaar that we **lost** each other twice.
sentences.translation: Bozorda shunchalik ko'p odam **bor ediki**, ikki marta bir-birimizni **yo'qotib qo'ydik**.

examples.title: Past habits and states: when I was a child
examples.description: O'tmishdagi takroriy harakat va tugagan holat — Past Simple (used to ham mumkin, → 18-dars). O'zbekchada ko'pincha «-ardi / -ar edi».

sentences.text: When I was a child, we **spent** every summer at my grandparents' farm.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda har yozni bobomlarning fermasida **o'tkazardik**.

sentences.text: At university, Emma **worked** in a café at weekends to pay her rent.
sentences.translation: Universitetda o'qiyotganida Emma ijara haqini to'lash uchun dam olish kunlari kafeda **ishlardi**.

sentences.text: My father **walked** five kilometres to school every day, even in winter.
sentences.translation: Otam har kuni, hatto qishda ham maktabga besh kilometr piyoda **borardi**.

sentences.text: Before smartphones, people **wrote** down phone numbers in little notebooks.
sentences.translation: Smartfonlardan oldin odamlar telefon raqamlarini kichkina daftarchalarga **yozib qo'yishardi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **lived** in Manchester for six years, but he **moved** back home in 2020.
sentences.translation: Bekzod olti yil Manchesterda **yashadi**, lekin 2020-yilda vataniga **qaytdi**.

sentences.text: We **didn't have** a car then, so we **travelled** everywhere by bus.
sentences.translation: U paytda mashinamiz **yo'q edi**, shuning uchun hamma joyga avtobusda **borardik**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **play** a musical instrument when you were at school?
sentences.translation: Maktabda o'qiganingizda biror cholg'u asbobini **chalarmidingiz**?

sentences.text: In the nineties, mobile phones **cost** a fortune and only rich people **had** them.
sentences.translation: To'qsoninchi yillarda mobil telefonlar juda **qimmat edi**, ular faqat boylarda **bor edi**.

sentences.text: Every evening Grandma **told** us stories while she **knitted** socks.
sentences.translation: Har kuni kechqurun buvim paypoq **to'qir ekan**, bizga ertaklar **aytib berardi**.

sentences.text: Tom **smoked** for years, but he **gave up** when his daughter was born.
sentences.translation: Tom yillar davomida **chekdi**, lekin qizi tug'ilganda **tashladi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: How was your weekend in Khiva?
examples.description: Do'stlar suhbati: dam olish kunlari nima bo'lgani — Past Simple savollar, javoblar, inkor va ketma-ket voqealar.

sentences.text: — Hi, Nilufar! How **was** your weekend in Khiva?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Nilufar! Xivadagi dam olish kunlaring qanday **o'tdi**?

sentences.text: — Amazing! We **arrived** on Friday night and **stayed** inside the old city.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib! Juma kuni kechasi **yetib keldik** va eski shahar ichida **tunadik**.

sentences.text: — Lucky you! **Did** you **climb** the tall minaret near the main gate?
sentences.translation: — Omading bor ekan! Asosiy darvoza yonidagi baland minoraga **chiqdingmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, we **went** up at sunset — the view **was** unforgettable.
sentences.translation: — Ha, quyosh botayotganda **chiqdik** — manzara unutilmas **edi**.

sentences.text: — And what **did** you **eat**? I **heard** the green plov there is famous.
sentences.translation: — Nima **yedingiz**? U yerning shivit oshi mashhur deb **eshitganman**.

sentences.text: — We **tried** it on Saturday, but honestly I **didn't like** the colour.
sentences.translation: — Shanba kuni **tatib ko'rdik**, lekin rostini aytsam, rangi menga **yoqmadi**.

sentences.text: — Ha! How **did** you **get** there? By train or by plane?
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! U yerga qanday **bordingiz**? Poyezddami yoki samolyotda?

sentences.text: — We **took** the night train from Tashkent — the journey **lasted** almost fourteen hours.
sentences.translation: — Toshkentdan tungi poyezdda **bordik** — yo'l deyarli o'n to'rt soat **davom etdi**.

sentences.text: — Wow. **Did** you **buy** any souvenirs for your colleagues?
sentences.translation: — Voy. Hamkasblaringga biror esdalik **sotib oldingmi**?

sentences.text: — Of course! I **bought** you a small carpet — it's in my bag.
sentences.translation: — Albatta! Senga kichkina gilam **olib keldim** — sumkamda turibdi.
